name: Physical Prior / Transport Losses
aliases: Physical Prior / Transport Losses — Differentiable Transport Operator Loss, LA(s), Navier-Stokes based transport
definition: A per-frame transport loss that connects frame $t-1$ to $t$ and $t$ to $t+1$ using a differentiable transport operator to enforce physical fluid motion constraints.
summary: Physical Prior / Transport Losses enforce temporal coherence and physical plausibility in fluid reconstruction by minimizing discrepancies using a differentiable transport operator grounded in Navier-Stokes equations.
